teaser.en: An aromatic bush shrub with catkin-like spikes, and a Digo name it shares with two other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha porini chenye harufu nzuri na masuke yaliyo kama vishungi, na jina la Kidigo kinachoshiriki na mimea mingine miwili.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu, chenye milita mifupi ya maruwa madide, na dzina ra Chidigo rinarohumirwa piya kpwa mimea miiri yanjina.

summary.en: Mphatsa, also called mtsatsa, is a small aromatic shrub of the spurge family, common in dry bushland. Digo speakers also give the name mtsatsa to two Clerodendrum shrubs.
summary.sw: Mphatsa, unaoitwa pia mtsatsa, ni kichaka kidogo chenye harufu nzuri cha familia ya mibono, kinachopatikana kwa wingi katika vichaka vikavu. Wadigo pia huupa jina mtsatsa vichaka viwili vya Clerodendrum.
summary.dg: Mphatsa, unaoihwa piya mtsatsa, ni chitsaka chidide chenye arufu cha jamii ya mwono, chinachophahikana sana weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Adigo anahumira dzina mtsatsa piya kpwa vitsaka viiri vya Clerodendrum.

about.en:
*Mphatsa* is a small, much-branched shrub of the spurge family. Its leaves are oval, toothed and softly hairy, and they smell when crushed. The tiny flowers grow in short, catkin-like spikes at the leaf bases, and the female flowers are wrapped in small leafy bracts.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mphatsa* ni kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi cha familia ya mibono. Majani yake ni ya duaradufu, yenye meno kwenye kingo na manyoya laini, na hutoa harufu yakipondwa. Maua madogo sana huota katika masuke mafupi yaliyo kama vishungi kwenye vishina vya majani, na maua ya kike yamefunikwa na vijani vidogo vya kukinga ua (brakti).

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mphatsa* ni chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya mwono, chenye panda nyinji. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra tumbi, gana meno madide kanda-kanda na nyere ndide, na ganalavya arufu ganaphohopezwa. Maruwa madide sana ganamera kpwa milita mifupi phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda, na maruwa ga chichetu ganafunikpwa ni makodza madide.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and rocky places in East Africa and further east, into Arabia and India.
where.sw: Kinaota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka vizito na maeneo yenye mawe Afrika Mashariki na kuelekea mashariki zaidi, hadi Uarabuni na India.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, kpwenye vitsaka na phatu pha mawe, Afrika Mashariki na kure zaidi uphande wa mlairo wa dzuwa, hadi Uarabuni na India.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in East Africa and India the leaves are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na India majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina Afrika Mashariki na India, makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* and, in his name notes, *chitsatsa*, which he says is shared by Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. He gives no meaning. *Mtsatsa* is also Pakia's name for *Clerodendrum glabrum* and *C. incisum*, and the Mgombato dictionary gives *mtsatsa* as 'seedling'. There is no English name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* na, katika maelezo yake ya majina, *chitsatsa*, ambalo anasema linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hatoi maana yake. *Mtsatsa* pia ni jina ambalo Pakia analitumia kwa *Clerodendrum glabrum* na *C. incisum*, na Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtsatsa* kuwa 'mche'. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* na, kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina, *chitsatsa*, ambaro anagomba ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri. *Mtsatsa* piya ni dzina ambaro Pakia anarihumira kpwa *Clerodendrum glabrum* na *C. incisum*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mtsatsa* kukala ni mmea mdide uriodzangbwe kukula ('seedling'). Takuna dzina ra Chingereza kpwenye maandiko.

reason.en: Name Pakia also gives to Acalypha neptunica
reason.sw: Jina ambalo Pakia pia analitoa kwa Acalypha neptunica
reason.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa Acalypha neptunica

reason.sw: Vernonia hildebrandtii, jina linalosikika kwa kufanana
reason.dg: Vernonia hildebrandtii, wenye dzina rinarohalana na hiri
